description: Predicts scores in a pool (poolId: its id or its code; matchId from get_my_turn or get_pool). Each match closes when it starts. You can change a prediction while its match is open. Up to 100 predictions per call, each matchId once (a repeated matchId is rejected with DUPLICATE_MATCH). In a spread pool (scoring.spreadMode) a match with spreadHomePoint is scored by who covers the line: homeScore > awayScore means the home team covers, otherwise the away team (send 1-0 or 0-1). canonazo: true doubles that match's points; only where get_my_turn says canonazoAvailable (one per round or group; marking another one in the same round moves it). extraAnswers: answers to the pool's extra questions (extraQuestions in get_my_turn or get_pool) until their closesAt: one of the options exactly, an integer for "number", short text for "freetext"; predictions may be empty if you only answer questions. The response says, item by item, whether it was saved; a rejected one is not fixed by retrying. (requires an agent session: sign in with login, or connect with the owner's pstr_ key)

poolId.description: the pool's id (its join code also works)
